'''Robert Russell''' (c. 1858–18 May 1938) was an Irish mathematician and academic at [[Trinity College Dublin]] (TCD), who served as [[Erasmus Smith's Professor of Mathematics]] (1917–1921).

Robert Russell was born in [[Portadown]], [[County Armagh]], and was educated at Santry School, [[Portarlington, County Laois]]. He attended TCD, became a Scholar in 1877, and won the Brooke Prize, Bishop Law's Prize, McCullagh Prize, and Madden Prize.<ref name=obit>''[https://www.irishtimes.com/newspaper/archive/1938/0521/Pg006.html#Ar00605 TCD Bursar Dead]'', Obituary of Robert Russell, [[Evening Herald]], 5 May 1938, p. 14</ref> He was awarded BA in mathematics (1880), became a Fellow a few years later, and got his MA (1888). In 1887, he was elected a member of the [[London Mathematical Society]].<ref name=math_society>[https://books.google.com/books?id=Roy4AAAAIAAJ&dq=%22robert+russell%22+mathematics+tcd+-crewdson&pg=PA288 Proceedings of the London Mathematical Society, Volume 18] 7 April 1887, p. 288</ref> He spent his whole career at TCD, at various times serving as Junior Bursar, Junior Dean, Registrar of Chambers,<ref name=calendar>[http://www.ebooksread.com/authors-eng/ireland-trinity-college-dublin/the-dublin-university-calendar-goo/1-the-dublin-university-calendar-goo.shtml The Dublin university calendar online] TCD</ref> and from the early 1920s on, Senior Bursar.<ref name=espm>[http://www.archive.org/stream/calendar192223trinuoft/calendar192223trinuoft_djvu.txt REProfessors And Lecturers Of The University: Erasmus Smith's Professor of Mathematics: 1917 Robert Russell, M.A.F3] The Dublin University Calendar</ref>

He was [[Donegall Lecturer in Mathematics]] (1904–1907), Erasmus Smith's Professor of Mathematics (1917–1921), and became Senior Fellow in 1920.

==Selected papers==
* [https://www.jstor.org/stable/20490560?seq=1#page_scan_tab_contents Geometry of Surfaces Derived from Cubics], 26 June 1899
* [https://books.google.com/books?id=zZNRAAAAYAAJ&dq=%22robert+russell%22+mathematics+tcd+-crewdson+cubic&pg=PA295 Ruler Constructions in Connexion with Cubic Curves], 24 April 1893
* [https://books.google.com/books?id=mns_AQAAIAAJ&dq=%22robert+russell%22+mathematics+tcd+-crewdson+cubic&pg=PA373 On a Theorem in Higher Algebra], [[The Quarterly Journal of Pure and Applied Mathematics]], Volume 21, 23 May 2016
